fichas.title: UK Structure Gauges and Clearances: UIC Kinematic Gauge Profiles
fichas.summary: Introduces UK railway structure gauges and shows UIC reference profiles GA, GB, GB+ and GC. The accompanying text describes the kinematic envelope and explains that infrastructure clearances must account for vehicle size and dynamic behaviour. Dimensions are in millimetres.
uses: Checking the safe passage of rail vehicles and their loads
Designing and assessing railway infrastructure clearances

fichas.title: New Construction Gauge Derived from the UIC GC Reference Profile
fichas.summary: Diagram of a new-construction railway gauge for a mixed-traffic railway, showing track centres, contact-wire and feeder-wire heights, walkways, cable troughs and platform clearance. Notes qualify applicability and explain that some clearances depend on the selected kinematic envelope, traffic and operating conditions. Dimensions are in millimetres.
uses: Locating overhead wires, walkways, cable troughs and platforms
